products.name: Monday.com AI
products.note: Work OS AI; project automation; cross-functional data; Israeli data transfer considerations

profile_text.body:
monday.com is a Tel Aviv-based public company (Nasdaq: MNDY) that describes itself as an AI work platform designed for both human workers and AI agents. The company's site presents its core offering as a unified environment where AI agents operate alongside people to execute, manage, and operate work together, with the platform emphasizing that its agents are given relevant context before acting to improve accuracy. The site also highlights enterprise-grade AI infrastructure with built-in data privacy, governance, permissions, and compliance capabilities.

The company's tracked AI product, Monday.com AI, is categorized under Notes, Knowledge, and Meetings and functions as a work operating system with project automation and cross-functional data capabilities. The product note flags Israeli data transfer considerations, relevant given the company's Tel Aviv headquarters. monday.com holds SEC registrant status under CIK 0001845338 and has 159 recorded points of legal exposure tied to Illinois jurisdiction, though no specific litigation cases are detailed in the available data.
